data_availability_observation.summary: Indonesian listed golf operator annual reports prioritise financial statements, ownership structure, board profiles, and segment-level revenue commentary. Operational specifics (grass varieties, irrigation vendor, fertilizer cost, POS system, booking platform, caddy structure, cart fleet) are systematically absent. The richest disclosure areas are: (a) total headcount + departmental count for pure-play operators; (b) round volume + monthly distribution; (c) F&B revenue split by outlet; (d) membership accounting (refundable vs transferable); (e) land area + insurance coverage; (f) tax audit history.
